Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Doris Ogih DBA 40 Love Foundation/USTA to host a Juneteenth Tennis Event at
  700 Warren Ln., Edward Vincent Park/ Donald Bly Tennis Complex, on Saturday,
  June 18, 2022, from 10:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. (Activity No.00341553)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Councilman Eloy Morales DBA City of Inglewood host a Juneteenth in LA Parade
  and the Freedom Fest Event at 231 S Grevillea Ave., on Sunday, June 19, 2022,
  from 11:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (Activity No.00341497)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  Forest Fykes DBA Greater Works new Life Center to host a Family Community
  Sunday Event at 525 N. Market St., Private Property, on Sunday, June 26, 2022,
  from 1:00 p.m. – 4:00 p.m. (Activity No.00341518)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #4:  Janae’ Huff DBA KOV to host an Inglewoods Vegan Event on Grevillea Ave.,
  between Manchester and Nutwood, Public Property, on Saturday, August 20, 2022,
  from 11:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m. (Activity No.00341486)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.
